name: Living Nexus Dedication
prerequisites:
trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or
Religion
text: Whether through happenstance or hours of rigorous training, you have discovered within yourself the ability to breathe in the magic around you. You have an invisible, internal nexus of energy and have learned how to control your absorption of others' magical energy and store it in this internal nexus. You gain the Absorb Magic reaction and the Overflowing Blade action. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your nexus DC.
